versions.content: { DR AFT } The function shall p ut the controller in the specified mode given in the parameter ‘CtrlMode’ : o Upon mode ETH_MODE_DOWN the driver shall :  Disable Tx/Rx communication of the Ethernet controller  Reset all transmit and receive buffers (i.e. ignore all p ending transmission and reception requests) o Upon mode ETH_MODE_ACTIVE:  Enable all transmit and receive buffers  Activate Rx/Tx communication of the Ethernet controller

The function shall put the controller in the specified mode given in the parameter 'CtrlMode': • Upon mode ETH_MODE_DOWN the driver shall: – Disable Tx/Rx communication of the Ethernet controller – Reset all transmit and receive buffers (i.e. ignore all pending transmission and reception requests) • Upon mode ETH_MODE_ACTIVE: – Enable all transmit and receive buffers – Activate Rx/Tx communication of the Ethernet controller
